Definition: from G2060 and G1096; born of Hermes; Hermogenes, an apostate Christian:--Hermogenes.
BiblicalUsage: Hermogenes is a person named once in Scripture, in 2 Timothy. The full story lives on the Hermogenes profile, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: God keeps Hermogenes in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
